Patch 1.2.4

Hello everyone, today's patchnotes are below. We'd like to add that we'll be doing a small change in how we work to make it more productive on our end: We will be switching to a 2 week patch cycle. What this means is that you can still expect small patches & marketplace updates every week, but we'll be holding off bigger changes to release in batches every 2nd week. So consider this week the first of this cycle, and next week should be an update with a bit more content.

The reason of this change is to increase productivity: Patching every week comes at a higher "process cost" which eats away at precious dev time. By having only small patches every second week, we have more time to do development. We also ask that you do not expect huge custom patches in the coming weeks as a lot of work is going towards 1.3. We still have some nice things planned before then 🙂

  • The Berserker's Hunger buff now only work on Player kills without Rebirth Trauma
  • The Berserker's Hunger healing has been reduced to 0.65% per kill
  • The item level of the Berserker Weapoons has been increased to 59. This puts them in line with Obsidian Tier 6.
  • The icon for the Berserker Weapons in the Item Guide has been updated
  • Increase the number of packs needed for the Veroe Harvest Festival from 60 to 80
  • A new system has been put in place to prevent players from using portals while on Rebirth Trauma during the Golden Plains Battle and the Veroe Harvest Festival
  • Ser Meatball's skills have been updated to have full snowlion mount skills.
  • Labor costs and fishing rod crafts have been fixed.
  • Missing recipe for Sirensong and Andelph rudder designs using schematic scraps has been added.
  • Hellkissed crafting recipes have been added for sunlight archeum essence.
  • The Ultimate Fishing Rod Design can now be crafted with 60 Fisher King Coin. These can be acquired via the Mirage Isle Fishing Tournament
  • Vanity petarmor has been fixed.
  • Gallant mount movement speeds have been increased to 11.5 m/s.
  • Few VFX fixes

== Patch 1.2.4 ==

Hello everyone, today's patchnotes are below.
We'd like to add that we'll be doing a small change in how we work to make it more productive on our end: We will be switching to a 2 week patch cycle. What this means is that you can still expect small patches & marketplace updates every week, but we'll be holding off bigger changes to release in batches every 2nd week. So consider this week the first of this cycle, and next week should be an update with a bit more content.

The reason of this change is to increase productivity: Patching every week comes at a higher "process cost" which eats away at precious dev time. By having only small patches every second week, we have more time to do development. We also ask that you do not expect huge custom patches in the coming weeks as a lot of work is going towards 1.3. We still have some nice things planned before then 🙂

* The Berserker's Hunger buff now only work on Player kills without Rebirth Trauma
* The Berserker's Hunger healing has been reduced to 0.65% per kill
* The item level of the Berserker Weapoons has been increased to 59. This puts them in line with Obsidian Tier 6.
* The icon for the Berserker Weapons in the Item Guide has been updated
* Increase the number of packs needed for the Veroe Harvest Festival from 60 to 80
* A new system has been put in place to prevent players from using portals while on Rebirth Trauma during the Golden Plains Battle and the Veroe Harvest Festival
* Ser Meatball's skills have been updated to have full snowlion mount skills.
* Labor costs and fishing rod crafts have been fixed.
* Missing recipe for Sirensong and Andelph rudder designs using schematic scraps has been added.
* Hellkissed crafting recipes have been added for sunlight archeum essence.
* The Ultimate Fishing Rod Design can now be crafted with 60 Fisher King Coin. These can be acquired via the Mirage Isle Fishing Tournament
* Vanity petarmor has been fixed.
* Gallant mount movement speeds have been increased to 11.5 m/s.
* Few VFX fixes
